title: CMA Site Tools
description: Site-specific tools surfaced as an extra group in the CMA tools launcher. Read by cma/tools_catalog.inc from data/cma_tools.json (legacy name: data/tools.json).

$comment.description: Free-text note for whoever opens the file

groups.description: One folder per group in the launcher. A group whose items all resolve to nothing is skipped.

label.description: Link text. An item without a label is skipped.

href.description: Target. An absolute href (/tools/x.php, https://...) opens in a new tab; a relative one loads in the CMA shell. An item without an href is skipped.

badge.description: Access badge: A = admin, D = developer. A D item is hidden from non-developers; an A item is shown but the tool itself enforces access.
